thread:
olivia.sec: Announcement: starting 2026-09-01 access to the Redwood Admin Console (web UI + API admin endpoints) will require hardware-backed MFA (FIDO2) for all employees with any privileged role. This replaces soft-totp and SMS for admin roles.

olivia.sec: Reason: recent audit showed high risk from shared authenticator seeds and recovery codes. FIDO2 reduces phishing and credential reuse risk and aligns with our SOC2 and FedRAMP prep.

olivia.sec: Timeline:
- Today: announcement
- Enrollment window: 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31
- Enforcement: 2026-09-01 00:00 UTC (console access blocked for admins without a registered FIDO device)

olivia.sec: Who is impacted: anyone with roles `admin:*`, `infra-team`, `sre:ops`, or `security:incident` on production orgs. Non-privileged devs are NOT required immediately, but encouraged to enroll.

olivia.sec: Enrollment steps:
1) Visit https://console.redwood-inference.com/account/mfa
2) Click "Register security key" and follow browser prompt (use FIDO2/U2F keys or platform authenticators like TouchID)
3) Optionally register a backup key and name it
4) If you cannot procure hardware, open an exception with your manager and `sec:mfa-exc` (temporary soft-totp allowed for max 30 days)

max.eng: Question: what about service-to-service admin automation that calls admin APIs? How will automation authenticate?

olivia.sec: Good Q. Machine/service accounts should use our admin service-token flow (short-lived bearer tokens with attestations). We will publish an SDK call pattern and a migration guide. Hardware MFA is for human interactive logins only.

paul.sre: We have a few on-call contractors who cannot get company-issued keys immediately. Are contractor accounts in scope?

olivia.sec: Contractors with privileged roles are in scope. Exceptions are allowed but must include an approved mitigation (IP allowlist, reduced TTL, and manager approval). Submit via the Security Exceptions form; SRE should attach an onboarding plan.

mfa-bot: enrollment-scan: scanned accounts: 128 users flagged as privileged; 46 have registered FIDO devices; 82 pending enrollment. Report posted to #security-scans. :warning:

max.eng: Is there a bulk enrollment option for teams to self-serve via admin APIs?

olivia.sec: Yes, we will publish a bulk enrollment API for org admins that records device metadata and sends invite emails. That API requires a scoped service token; I'll post docs in Confluence by EOD.

sara.ciso: This is important for reducing attack surface. Please make sure managers get a heads-up and we coordinate key procurement for contractors.

olivia.sec: We'll schedule two drop-in office hours next week to help with procurement and enrollment. If anyone expects issues, file a ticket labeled `sec-mfa-enroll`.

paul.sre: Noted. We'll prioritize oncall and infra leads and run the bulk invites.

olivia.sec: Final note: after enforcement we will block admin web sessions that do not have an attached FIDO assertion. Automation and API clients are unaffected if they use the service-token flow. Reach out in-thread for edge cases. :lock:
